name: Meatless Sloppy Joes
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ¼ cup hickory-smoked barbecue sauce, or to your preference

steps: Add olive oil to pan over medium-high heat.
Add onions, bell pepper, and carrots and cook for 3–4 minutes
Add rice, chili beans, and barbecue sauce and cook for approximately 10–15 minutes, stirring frequently to heat thoroughly.

culture.text: A sloppy joe is a sandwich consisting of ground meat, onions, tomato sauce or ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, and other seasonings served on a hamburger bun.
